text.text_excerpt: I've been here twice now. The first time was early afternoon. Brunch crowd had died down. The restaurant wasn't real busy. Service was great. I ordered the All That Jazz and a quite strong mimosa. Enjoyed them both. The sausage patty had a weird taste tho. Second visit was in the height of brunch. It was post Ida and very busy. There was also a large party in the back room. The service was much slower. However, I'll cut them slack given the post Ida situation. I ordered the Tchoupitoulas. It was scrumptious. I'll definitely be back. That Tchoupitoulas is worth a return visit.

Okay, this place is amazing! I had the Hollygrove chicken biscuit, it's pretty filling, but some may want to add a side. My wife had the brunch burger. She got it with an over easy egg, which she said if there was any other kind of egg the sandwich would have needed a sauce. My opinion is it still needed a sauce, like a good spicy aioli! She got it with the side salad and balsamic vinegar which was so so good. Our waitress Bailey, was amazing, she was attentive but not overly in your face! She made the best mimosas! The coffee is also so fresh and great! The music was awesome too!

Went here for brunch on a Sunday. They mainly operate on reservations. I didn't make a reservation so we waited about 15mins to see if a reserved party would show. In the meantime, we saw several people were turned around due to being at capacity. I was wondering why their names weren't added to the waiting list should a party not show. After 15mins passed we received a text stating that our table was ready. We were greeted from our waitress with water. Complimentary pastries/ biscuits are not offered at this restaurant. Appetizer: We started off with the beignets, they were very light and flaky but also a bit on the greasy side. This dish is more of a dessert than an appetizer. Entree: F...
